comparison.objective: Candidate extracts a connector terminal; record locks a floating guide rod at its carriage-set position and verifies full travel.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade insertion beneath a tab and coordinated withdrawal versus carriage positioning, clamp closure, and crank-based travel verification.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective undamaged depinning, with exact force/damage limits missing. Record scores clamp timing/location, rod parallelism, full carriage travel, low lag, and hands-off completion.
comparison.reason: The record tests calibration and clamping of a motion guide, not release from a retaining latch.
